text:
Give Mira a heads-up before you leave rather than a sudden "we're going now." At 26 months, big feelings still outrun her ability to handle them, so an abrupt exit tips her over fast.

A couple of things that help, per the Child Development & Wellbeing Companion's guidance on toddler transitions:

- A five-minute and two-minute warning ("two more slides, then we go").
- A small closing ritual — wave bye to the swings, count steps to the gate — so leaving feels like a planned ending, not an interruption.
- Let her "help" decide the last activity, so she has a little control over how it ends.

These usually ease up as her transition skills catch up over the next few months.
